rv.q: His new project at NYU Skirball, Kramer/Fauci, lifts its script entirely from a November 1993 joint appearance on C-SPAN...
What moved me most was the complexity of this dynamic between these two men.
A great, impassioned, thoughtful conversation can make for entertainment as gripping as Buckley and Vidal’s rage matches.

cn.t: Daniel Fish's inventive docudrama transforms 1993 C-SPAN footage of Larry Kramer and Anthony Fauci into compelling theater, using absurdist staging and surreal touches to illuminate both AIDS-era politics and contemporary resonances.

vr.q: This world premiere production... feel as urgent and scorching as ever.
